Twelve directions of Q (speed check)
====================================

The prolate/oblate system measured along twelve directions of Q: the standard six plus alpha_Q = 10, 20, 40, 50, 70 and 80 deg at omega_Q = 0. Meant for judging how the GUI and the fit behave as directions are added. Needles (aspect 8, equatorial radius 50 A, 0.6 vol %, contrast 1e11) strongly aligned along the normal (|cos alpha|^30), plus platelets (aspect 1/8.3, equatorial radius 450 A, 1.2 vol %, contrast 0.6e11) whose axes lie in the substrate plane along x, only weakly aligned (|cos|^3 in both alpha and omega). The platelets dominate at low Q, the needles at high Q; the in-plane azimuths differ because the platelet axes prefer x.

Population 1: needles, strongly aligned (prolate)
  Radius            50 A (equatorial)
  Beta              8   (semi-axes R, R, beta R)
  Volume Fract      0.006
  Delta rho         1e+11 cm^-2
  Size distribution none {}
  P alpha           par1 0 deg, par2 30, par3 0
  B omega           par1 0 deg, par2 0, par3 0

Population 2: platelets, weakly aligned (oblate)
  Radius            450 A (equatorial)
  Beta              0.12   (semi-axes R, R, beta R)
  Volume Fract      0.012
  Delta rho         6e+10 cm^-2
  Size distribution none {}
  P alpha           par1 90 deg, par2 3, par3 0
  B omega           par1 0 deg, par2 3, par3 0

Directions (alpha_Q, omega_Q in deg; each has background 0.01 1/cm):
  Q along normal (alpha 0)        0.0    0.0
  alpha 30, omega 0              30.0    0.0
  alpha 60, omega 0              60.0    0.0
  in plane, omega 0 (x)          90.0    0.0
  in plane, omega 45             90.0   45.0
  in plane, omega 90 (y)         90.0   90.0
  alpha 10, omega 0              10.0    0.0
  alpha 20, omega 0              20.0    0.0
  alpha 40, omega 0              40.0    0.0
  alpha 50, omega 0              50.0    0.0
  alpha 70, omega 0              70.0    0.0
  alpha 80, omega 0              80.0    0.0

Data: Q 0.001 to 0.3 1/A, 120 log-spaced points, relative noise 0.02 (also the stored uncertainty), seed 0.
The *_start.anisa.json project has radius, volume fraction and orientation sharpness (plus eta and pack where used) moved by up to 25 % and set to fit.

Correct fit result: every fitted parameter returns to the values above within about two standard deviations, and chi^2/N is about 1.
